whyItMatters: CC_MD5 computes MD5 in objc, whose collisions defeat any security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace CC_MD5 with CC_SHA256 wherever the digest protects passwords, signatures, or untrusted data.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified CC_MD5, and security digests verify under the replacement.
